thread:
elena: heads-up — hitting a parity issue between hosted vectors/rerank API and the python SDK sample app. our evals crash because the response shape isn't what the sample app expects. anyone else seen this?
omar: can you paste an example of the two responses?
elena: sure. hosted API returns something like:
```json
{
  "candidates": [
    { "id": "doc-123", "score": 0.9123, "embedding": [0.01, -0.02, ...] }
  ]
}
```
but the Python SDK async client is returning:
```json
{
  "vectors": [
    { "id": "doc-123", "score": "0.9123", "values": [0.01, -0.02, ...] }
  ]
}
```
and our reranker code expects `candidates[*].score` as float and `embedding` key.
marta: yikes. we merged that typed-response refactor last week — it routed through the new dataclass normalizer. are you using the async `RerankClient` + the batching helper?
elena: yes async + `AsyncBatcher`. also noticed auth quirk: when token expires we get 401 and the client retries but doesn't refresh token before retrying which doubles error noise during onboarding.
sdk-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood/inference-python-sdk/issues/874 — "rerank response shape + token refresh race with async batcher" :eyes:
dave: I can repro locally. looks like `normalize_response()` coerces numeric scores to str when `values` present — bug introduced by the dataclass serializer treating numpy floats differently. also the key rename from `embedding`->`values` happened in transpile step.
qa: I have a failing integration test already. I'll add a test asserting exact keys + types for both sync/async clients and the batcher.
omar: proposed short-term fix: add a `preserve_response_shape=true` compatibility flag in the client that returns the legacy keys (`candidates`, `embedding`, score=float) and keep the new dataclass outputs behind `typed_responses=True`. Also add a unit for async batcher retry flow. I'll draft a PR.
marta: long-term we should pick a single canonical response shape in the spec and update examples + typing stubs. also update `examples/rerank-async/README.md` — current sample shows sync API which confuses new users during onboarding.
elena: thanks. prefer minimal break: ship patch release that restores old shape by default and deprecates it with a warning, then switch in major version later. also we need explicit doc blurb about auth refresh for async batcher.
dave: ok i'll open a hotfix PR that: 1) preserves legacy keys by default, 2) fixes numeric coercion, 3) adds a test for token-refresh+retry race. assigning @omar for review. :thumbsup:
qa: will run e2e against the hosted mock and report flakiness. if green i'll mark regression test and add to CI matrix.
elena: awesome — thanks y'all. ping me if you want a failing repro script (I have one).
